content.short: NFThubs is a platform for any artist or creator to sell their work digitally. NFThubs promotes social projects worldwide.
content.description:
We have created NFThubs because we saw a need for a platform where artists anywhere in the world can onboard to sell their art on the Cardano blockchain. There are many different categories, from painters to instagram influences. From photographers to 3D artists, and so on.

Due to our unique payment solution called HydraPay we are able to organise the sales in such a way that part of the proceedings goes to social projects all over the world which we sponsor. These projects are the NFThubs and the intention is to make them independent and self sustainable.

We are calling upon all artists and content creators anywhere to join. Together we will create a Global Artist Community which will promote art all over the world while at the same time making the world a slight better place, Cardano-style.

HydraPay also has another unique feature: if you know an artist which you think ought to Drop on NFThubs, you can contact us and we will tell you how you can become an independently operating art agent.

We look forward to bringing the world together with the power of art and creativity!
